text: Managing a team effectively requires a delicate balance of several key skills. Clear communication is the foundation, ensuring everyone understands their roles and the team’s goals. It is equally important to master delegation, assigning tasks based on each member's strengths rather than doing everything yourself. Providing regular, constructive feedback helps people grow, while also recognizing their achievements to boost motivation. Finally, when disagreements arise, address them quickly and fairly. A good manager listens to all sides and focuses on finding a solution that benefits the project, turning potential conflicts into opportunities for stronger collaboration.
